## Scope

- [ ] This pull request changes one bounded seam.
- [ ] Documentation, schemas, tests, and runtime behavior remain aligned.
- [ ] No real private, legal, evidentiary, recipient, or confidential material is included.
- [ ] No credential, local filesystem path, source locator, or personal data is included.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run release:scan`

## Boundaries

State what this change creates and what it explicitly does not create. A green
check does not create legal or evidentiary conclusions, professional approval,
release approval, product candidacy, or external-use authorization.
